question: Which deposited DuPage samples, expression features and biological units support the planned activation-state comparison?
decision: Choose a per-library descriptive FPKM route, a group-only route, or a dependent hold; qualify raw-read recovery without starting reprocessing.
strongest_rival: Incorrect source or feature identity, unknown mouse/pool nesting and sample-specific assembly identifiers can produce false contrasts or pseudoreplication.
discriminator: Join GEO GSM-to-SRX-to-BioSample against ENA experiment/run metadata; audit exact gene label and mm10 genomic-span identity across every file without symbol-only joins. Does not resolve unreported biological units or exon models.
exposure_record: Owner and agent have read the published outcomes. Initial review inspected headers and archive members. This stage additionally retrieved source XML, ENA metadata and file headers; no biological contrasts have been calculated.
biological_unit: Source biological preparation; individual mouse, pool membership and cross-state pairing remain unknown. This stage counts files/features, not animals.
nesting_and_overlap: Twelve libraries from one study; GSM1423627 excluded by authors. All reuse of these libraries is shared-source reanalysis. Replicate labels do not prove pairing or independence.
population_and_selection: Female C57BL/6 healthy mosaic mice; spleen/LN sorted Foxp3-positive CD4+CD25+YFP+RFP+ Tregs, conditional Ezh2 HET or KO, observed CD62L high/low.
contrast: No biological contrast in S0; compare feature definitions and metadata of 12 deposited, 11 retained libraries and four merged group estimates.
endpoint: Sample/source crosswalk, feature eligibility, estimation-status and malformed-value checks, explicit route and dependent holds.
methods: Parse source SOFT and ENA TSV; require exact SRX and BioSample matches, unique run accessions. Read all gzip members without extraction. Qualify unique per-file gene_id=single gene_short_name plus exact locus, exclude XLOC/CUFF and ambiguous names, intersect 11 retained files. Retain statuses and raw FPKM strings. Separate exact symbol/locus crosswalk to merged file; no FPKM summation. No effect fitting, normalization or PCA.
missingness_and_exclusions: Keep excluded GSM1423627 in manifest and audit, omit it from primary 11-file intersection. Unknown mouse/pool/age/batch/pairing/annotation release stay unknown. Missing features are blank, never zero-filled.
multiplicity: No statistical tests or biological hypothesis family in metadata qualification.
precision_basis: Not applicable to identity/count checks; no biological-population uncertainty is estimated.
interpretation_limit: Qualified gene-labelled genomic spans do not establish exact transcript/exon models, matched chromatin, biological independence, temporal activation effects or functional outcomes.
stop_rule: Fail exact sample-source joins or malformed FPKM. If no common reference-labelled loci exist, hold per-library route. Unresolved count/unit identity holds inference only; no raw-read reprocessing starts.
amendment_reason: Initial exposed metadata qualification after owner execution authorization; biological contrasts remain prospective.
